{{Infobox/Generic |image=File:Zombie.png |caption=[[Zombie|{{Gray|Zombies}}]] spawn commonly on player islands.}} '''Mobs''' are computer-controlled entities, which will usually attack players. Killing enough of a specific kind of mob can grant the [[player]] levels for them in the [[Bestiary]]. [[SkyBlock]] has modified vanilla mobs to give them custom stats – {{stat|health}} and {{stat|damage}} – which determine their respective {{Blue|Mob Level}}, which will in turn scale the rewards for the player when defeated. Some higher tier enemies may have exclusive and useful drops. Additionally, '''Mobs''' are assigned {{green|1}} to {{green|3}} {{Blue|Mob Types}} and a {{Blue|Mob Category}}. == List == {{:Mobs/List}} == Mob Levels== * {{stat|hp}} and {{stat|damage}} determine {{Blue|Mob Levels}}. * A '''Mob''''s {{Blue|Level}} can be read atop its head, at the beginning of its name tag (e.g. {{Lv|1}} {{Mob|Graveyard Zombie}}). * A '''Mob''''s {{Blue|Level}} determines the amounts of [[Skill|{{turquoise|Skill XP}}]], {{c}} and {{Experience}} rewarded to the player when defeated. ===Formulas === For the overwhelming majority of '''Mobs''', the following rewards are calculated depending on several factors. {|class="wikitable ct" !Mob Category !\text{Mob Level} Formula

Can only be damaged with an [[Axe]] or [[Huntaxe]]. | {{Ench|Woodsplitter}} | {{Attr|Woodland Ruler}} | {{MobSprite|Chillshot}} |} == Mob Categories == ===Catacombs Mobs=== {{Main|Dungeon Mobs}} Dungeon mobs spawn in {{zone|The Catacombs}}. They have high amounts of {{stat|hp}}, {{stat|damage}} and {{stat|defense}} compared to regular mobs. Additionally, their stats increase as players clear the [[Dungeon]]. Some need to be killed to earn a [[Dungeon Secrets]], whilst others protect [[Dungeons Rooms]]. ===Kuudra Mobs=== {{Main|Kuudra}} Kuudra mobs spawn in {{zone|Kuudra's Hollow}}, in waves. Their stats increase with the number of waves. While not strictly necessary to complete a Kuudra Fight, they also award {{Tokens}} which can be spent in a special shop, granting perks. === Spooky Mobs === {{Main|Spooky Mobs}} Spooky Mobs spawn during the [[Spooky Festival]] and have a chance to drop {{Item|Green Candy}} or {{Item|Purple Candy}}. Collecting these grants points towards the [[Spooky Festival]]. === Sea Creatures === {{Main|Sea Creatures}} Sea Creatures have a chance to spawn when {{Skl|fishing}}. This chance is a percentage, expressed as {{stat|scc}}. They drop unique fishing drops. {{Tabview|-|Sea Creatures/List|button=Show Sea Creatures}} === Mythological Ritual Mobs === {{Main|Mythological Creature}} Mythological Ritual Mobs will spawn when a red [[Griffin Burrows|Griffin Burrow]] is dug up with an {{Item|Ancestral Spade}} (or one of its upgrades). They spawn with different stats depending on the rarity of the {{Item|Griffin Pet}} equipped. === Slayer === {{Main|Slayer}} {{Mcat|Slayer Bosses}} and {{Mcat|Slayer Minibosses}} are exclusive to [[Slayer Quest]]s. * While active and incomplete, {{Mcat|Slayer Minibosses}} may spawn: stronger than "normal" mobs, they award a larger amount of {{Skill|Combat|XP}}, significantly speeding up the completion of that specific [[Slayer]] quest. * Upon completion, a {{Mcat|Slayer Boss}} appears. They tend to possess the following characteristics: **Even higher {{stat|hp}}; **{{stat|hp}} regeneration when unable to damage players after about {{green|15}} seconds.{{MoreInfoNeeded|Isn't also if the player does not damage them?}} **Performs critical attacks when players are not moving, dragging them inwards and dealing high {{DamageType|melee}} which gets stronger the more players are dragged.{{MoreInfoNeeded|"the more players are dragged" ?????When was this documented? Does this date to the precambrian era?}} **Teleports to the player if they are unable to reach the player.{{MoreInfoNeeded|Would be nice to know the criterion(a)}} == Trivia == *A {{Item|Phoenix Pet}} can be obtained from killing any mob on [[Public Island]]s. A {{Item|Phoenix Pet|rarity=special}} has a {{Chance|0.000017%|1|6,000,000}} chance to drop, and a {{Item|Phoenix Pet|rarity=very special}} has a {{Chance|0.000003%|1|30,000,000}} chance to drop. *Mobs that have {{Stat|Hp|1B}} are the {{MobSprite|Kalhuiki Tribe Member}} and the {{MobSprite|Deathmite}}. Meanwhile, the [[Wither Dragons]] have {{Stat|hp|900M}} each. *{{NPCSprite|Derpy}}'s {{AN|DOUBLE MOBS HP!!!}} perk {{red|doubles}} the {{stat|hp}} of all '''Mobs'''. *The {{zone|Gold Mine}} is the only public island that does not have any '''Mobs'''. *[[Slayer]] Bosses used to have a Mob Level formula based on their max {{Stat|Health}}. {{Cite Discord|staff=yes|url=https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1530266616284319866|user=mrkeith|date=7/24/26, 1:33 PM (EST)|text= as far as i can tell it's a function of the max health of the entity int lvl = Math.sqrt(maxHealth) / 2 rounded to nearest 10 }}
